name: Gyaku Katei Kyoushi ~Kanojo wa Boku no Sensei ni Shite Dorei~
original_name: 逆家庭教師 ～彼女は僕の先生にして奴隷～
source:
My name is Naoya Seta. I'm an unfortunate student who, despite not having any particular problems with my grades, ended up needing a private tutor simply because I failed to get into my first-choice school.

In order to make time for my daily routine of browsing pornographic websites, I deliberately chose to only get accepted into the school closest to my home.

The attempt to do so has completely backfired...orz

This means that even my part-time job, which combines my hobby with practical benefits, will be put on hold.

I have to do something... I have no choice but to be a little mean to them and get them to quit quickly.

I had thought that way, but after seeing the tutor who came to our house, I changed my mind.

During the first lesson, I pretended to be racking my brain over the handout I was given, while sitting next to the well-developed student.

I started planning what kind of kinky things I would do and how I would do them with the female college student who was my tutor...

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704101105/http://silica-gel.jp/product/04/gya/#tag_spec]official website[/url]]
translation:
我叫濑田直也。尽管成绩没有任何问题，我却因为没考上第一志愿学校而不得不找家教，是个倒霉的学生。

为了给每天浏览色情网站腾出时间，我故意只考上离家最近的学校。
这个计划完全适得其反……orz连将兴趣与实际收益结合的兼职工作也只能暂停。
我必须做点什么……只能稍微对她们坏一点，让她们尽快辞职。

我本来这么想，但看见来到家里的家教后改变了主意。
第一次授课时，我坐在发育良好的女大学生身旁，假装对讲义绞尽脑汁，同时开始计划要对这位女家教做哪些变态的事，以及该怎么做……

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704101105/http://silica-gel.jp/product/04/gya/#tag_spec]官方网站[/url]]
